# Atlas Kubernetes Operator - (current)

> Manage Atlas resources within Kubernetes using Atlas Kubernetes Operator, which integrates data services with your cloud-native applications.

- [Configure Project Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-alert-configurations.md): Configure alerts using Atlas Kubernetes Operator to monitor database deployments in your Atlas projects.
- [Back Up Your Atlas Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-back-up-deployment.md): Enable cloud backup for Atlas clusters using Kubernetes Operator by configuring backup policies and schedules.
- [Configure a Backup Compliance Policy](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-bcp.md): Configure a Backup Compliance Policy using Atlas Kubernetes Operator to protect backup data, with strict requirements and limitations on actions.
- [Atlas Kubernetes Operator Changelog](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-changelog.md): Explore the changelog for Atlas Kubernetes Operator, detailing new features, improvements, and fixes across various releases.
- [Compatibility](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-compatibility.md)
- [Configure Audit Logs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-configure-audit-logs.md): Configure audit logs using Atlas Kubernetes Operator to track system activity and customize auditing filters for MongoDB deployments.
- [Configure Federated Authentication Using the Atlas Kubernetes Operator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-configure-federated-authentication.md): Configure federated authentication in Atlas Kubernetes Operator by updating the `AtlasFederatedAuth` Custom Resource to manage role mappings and organization settings.
- [Configure Teams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-configure-teams.md): Configure teams in Atlas Kubernetes Operator to manage project access roles for multiple users at the organization level.
- [Create an Atlas Search Index with Kubernetes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-create-atlas-search-index.md): Create Atlas Search indexes using Kubernetes with the Atlas Kubernetes Operator, specifying configurations and deployment resources.
- [Create a Atlas Vector Search Index with Kubernetes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-create-vector-search-index.md): Create Atlas Vector Search indexes on Kubernetes clusters using the Atlas Kubernetes Operator.
- [Atlas Kubernetes Operator Dry Run](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-dry-run.md)
- [Encrypt Data Using a Key Management Service](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-encryption-at-rest-customer-keys.md): Configure encryption at rest in Atlas using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud KMS with the Atlas Kubernetes Operator.
- [Atlas Kubernetes Operator for Atlas for Government Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-for-gov.md): Learn how to configure and use the Atlas Kubernetes Operator to manage resources, deployments, and users in your MongoDB Atlas for Government environments.
- [Get Started with the Atlas Kubernetes Operator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-get-started.md)
- [Import Atlas Projects into Atlas Kubernetes Operator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-import-projects.md): Import Atlas projects into Atlas Kubernetes Operator using CLI commands to export configurations in a compatible format for Kubernetes or Openshift clusters.
- [Independent Custom Resource Definitions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-independent-crd.md)
- [Integrate with Third-Party Services](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-integrate-third-party.md): Integrate Atlas with third-party services using Atlas Kubernetes Operator to receive alerts and analyze performance metrics.
- [View Metrics and Troubleshoot Resource Issues](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-metrics.md): View and analyze performance metrics collected by Atlas Kubernetes Operator.
- [Monitor Your Atlas Database Deployments](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-monitoring.md)
- [Configure Network Peering](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-network-peering.md): Configure network peering for Atlas clusters on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure using Atlas Kubernetes Operator.
- [Manage Private Endpoints for an Federated Database Instance](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-private-link-datafederation.md): Configure and manage private endpoints for federated database instances using Atlas Kubernetes Operator with AWS PrivateLink to connect to MongoDB Atlas.
- [Manage Private Endpoints for Dedicated Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-private-link-dedicated.md): Configure and manage private endpoints for dedicated clusters using Atlas Kubernetes Operator on AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Link, and Private Service Connect.
- [Manage Private Endpoints](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-private-link.md): Manage private endpoints with Atlas Kubernetes Operator to enable secure private connectivity for dedicated clusters and federated database instances in MongoDB Atlas.
- [Helm Charts Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-quick-start-helm.md): Create your first Atlas cluster using Helm Charts with Atlas Kubernetes Operator, including setting up credentials and deploying database users.
- [Quick Start](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-quick-start.md): Create your first Atlas cluster using Kubernetes configuration files with the Atlas Kubernetes Operator.
- [Configure Secret Storage](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-secret-storage.md): Configure secret storage for Atlas Kubernetes Operator using Kubernetes secrets, GitOps, or external tools like HashiCorp Vault.
- [Configure Access to Atlas Using Service Accounts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-service-accounts.md): Configure Atlas Kubernetes Operator access to Atlas using Atlas API Service Accounts instead of Programmatic API Keys.
- [Set Up Data Federation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-set-up-data-federation.md): Set up a federated database instance in Atlas using Kubernetes configuration files with Atlas Kubernetes Operator, connecting AWS S3 and an Atlas cluster.
- [Manage Atlas Stream Processing](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-stream-processing.md): Manage stream processing workspaces and connections using Atlas Kubernetes Operator for real-time data processing with MongoDB Query API.
- [Set Up Unified Cloud Provider Integrations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-unified-access.md): Set up unified access for AWS IAM roles in Atlas using Kubernetes Operator, including modifying IAM role trust policies and authorizing access.
- [Verify Integrity of Atlas Kubernetes Operator Packages](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-verify-packages.md)
- [Set Up X.509 Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/ak8so-x509.md): Set up X.509 authentication for database access using Atlas Kubernetes Operator with options for Atlas-managed or self-managed certificates.
- [``AtlasBackupPolicy`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasbackuppolicy-custom-resource.md): Configure backup policies for Atlas deployments using the `AtlasBackupPolicy` custom resource in Kubernetes.
- [``AtlasBackupSchedule`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasbackupschedule-custom-resource.md): Configure a backup schedule for your AtlasDeployment using the AtlasBackupSchedule custom resource with the Atlas Kubernetes Operator.
- [``AtlasCustomRole`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlascustomrole-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasDatabaseUser`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasdatabaseuser-custom-resource.md): Configure database users in Atlas projects using the `AtlasDatabaseUser` custom resource with Kubernetes Operator, including authentication and connection secrets.
- [``AtlasDataFederation`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasdatafederation-custom-resource.md): Configure a federated database instance in Atlas using the `AtlasDataFederation` custom resource with Kubernetes Operator.
- [``AtlasDeployment`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasdeployment-custom-resource.md): Configure MongoDB clusters or Flex clusters in Atlas using the `AtlasDeployment` custom resource, with guidance on migration to Flex clusters and Kubernetes Operator updates.
- [``AtlasFederatedAuth`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasfederatedauth-custom-resource.md): Configure federated authentication for Atlas organizations using the `AtlasFederatedAuth` custom resource with role mappings and domain restrictions.
- [``AtlasIPAccessList`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasipaccesslist-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasNetworkContainer`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasnetworkcontainer-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasNetworkPeering`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasnetworkpeering-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasOrgSettings`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasorgsettings-custom-resource.md): The AtlasOrgSettings custom resource allows you to modify the specific organization settings.
- [``AtlasPrivateEndpoint`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasprivateendpoint-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasProject`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasproject-custom-resource.md): Configure an Atlas project using the AtlasProject custom resource with the Atlas Kubernetes Operator, including IP access lists, teams, and alerts.
- [``AtlasSearchIndexConfig`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlassearchindexconfig-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasStreamConnection`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasstreamconnection-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasStreamWorkspace`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasstreamworkspace-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasTeam`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasteam-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasThirdPartyIntegration`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/atlasthirdpartyintegration-custom-resource.md)
- [``AtlasBackupCompliancePolicy`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/bcp-custom-resource.md)
- [``Cluster`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/cluster-custom-resource.md)
- [Configure Access to Atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/configure-ak8so-access-to-atlas.md): Configure Atlas Kubernetes Operator access by setting up secrets for organization ID and API keys or Service Accounts, and explore additional features like network peering and encryption.
- [Custom Resources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/custom-resources.md): Explore the custom resource definitions supported by Atlas Kubernetes Operator for managing Atlas configurations.
- [``DatabaseUser`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/databaseuser-custom-resource.md)
- [Migrate a Flex cluster to a Dedicated cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/flex-to-dedicated-migration.md)

- [``Group`` Custom Resource](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/group-custom-resource.md)
- [Atlas Kubernetes Operator](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/operator/current/index.md): Manage Atlas resources within Kubernetes using Atlas Kubernetes Operator, which integrates data services with your cloud-native applications.
